_notes: V1 (hsk.microtask_contract@1) stays the contract for WP-KERNEL-012's @1 MT files; V2 applies from the next WP on.
This MT JSON is the status and recovery surface; paperwork is handwritten; parent.wp_contract_digest and context_digest are optional (null) until Handshake exists.
Policy prose lives in rule_refs (Codex CX ids), never in instance fields; keys starting with '_' are author comments and are ignored by readers.
execution.depends_on is the only depends_on; lifecycle.depends_on and dependencies.depends_on are removed.
Versioned validation_vN / remediation_vN blocks become verdicts[] and submissions[]; verdicts[].payload keeps the existing hsk.mt_validation_verdict@1 write-up.
Value mapping from V1 labels: PASS_Vn -> phase passed / decision pass; FAIL_Vn -> needs_remediation / fail; PARTIAL -> validating / inconclusive plus a blockers[] entry.
lifecycle.phase is authoritative; lifecycle.status is the derived label <DECISION>_V<n> kept for old readers.
execution.lane: repo values PRODUCT_CODE_BACKEND and PRODUCT_CODE_BACKEND_PLUS_NATIVE map to implementation; operator decision pending (see _repo_lane_values).

failure_class keeps the repo meaning: a cause id (e.g. C1V-088-GUARD-STALE). failure_kind is the separate product|infrastructure|flaky classification; only product failures become MT remediation (CX-VAL-006).

lifecycle.rounds_without_output counts wasted rounds and resets on a new pushed commit or new verdict; at 2 the phase becomes needs_new_approach (status label NEEDS_NEW_APPROACH) until a diagnosis in diagnosis_refs names a new cause (CX-EXEC-013).

gameplan_ref names the gameplan this MT is gated by: the WP gameplan .GOV/task_packets/<WP_ID>/gameplan.yaml, or .GOV/task_packets/<WP_ID>/gameplans/<MT_ID>.yaml when the MT has its own steps (parent = the WP gameplan); created and edited only with the gameplan skill (CX-GP-001).

Closure loop (CX-VAL-008): a fail verdict carries a typed remediation (_remediation_shape); a resubmission after a fail changes a path in remediation.affected_code_refs or cites a new diagnosis_id in submissions[].diagnosis_ref, else it is not admitted; a diagnosis is recorded once as blockers[].diagnosis (_diagnosis_shape) and cited by lifecycle.diagnosis_refs in recording order. Text fields of these shapes are one line of at most 120 chars, gameplan writing style.

Proof binding (CX-VAL-009): verdicts[].test_run names the round candidate_commit, started_at and completed_at and one artifact_ref per failure; a fail decision needs at least one product failure_kind for this MT in that test_run; lifecycle.invalidated_by_commit records the round candidate whose diff intersected proof.relevant_input_paths and returned a passed MT to ready_for_validation. Every proof run uses the HBR test_entrypoint command and config only (CX-VAL-007).
The closure-loop fields (remediation, diagnosis, diagnosis_ref, test_run binding, invalidated_by_commit) are checked by agents by hand until Handshake exists.
_rule_refs_replaces: handoff (policy fields: model_reports, report_fields_required, worker_final_status, commit_policy)
_gameplan_ref_note: Path to the WP gameplan, or to .GOV/task_packets/{{WP_ID}}/gameplans/{{MT_ID}}.yaml when this MT has its own steps (parent = the WP gameplan); gameplan skill only (CX-GP-001).

_repo_lane_values._status: OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING: confirm this mapping, or keep the repo values as lane and record the vault value separately

proof._extra_build_proofs_note: Codex CX-VAL-005: proofs that need a build other than the union validation build are declared here at activation and all run in one extra build at the end of the WP. Empty list when none.

_submissions_entry_shape._diagnosis_ref_note: The diagnosis_id (blockers[].diagnosis) a resubmission after a fail verdict cites when it changes no path in remediation.affected_code_refs; null otherwise (CX-VAL-008).

_verdicts_entry_shape._test_run_note: candidate_commit is the round's frozen candidate SHA; started_at and completed_at bound the run and must not precede the round start; a result from another commit or older than the round start is infrastructure, no verdict; artifact_ref is the exact log, junit or screenshot ref per failure (CX-VAL-009).
_verdicts_entry_shape._remediation_note: Required (non-null, every field non-empty) when decision is fail; failed_acceptance_refs lie inside closure_unit.acceptance_refs; failed_check_refs name proof.checks[].check_id; expected, observed and repair_direction are one line of at most 120 chars in gameplan writing style; affected_code_refs are the paths a resubmission must change (CX-VAL-008).

_blockers_entry_shape._diagnosis_note: A diagnosis is recorded once, here; cause is one line of at most 120 chars in gameplan writing style; distinct_from lists every earlier diagnosis_id on this MT; lifecycle.diagnosis_refs cites diagnosis_id values in recording order and gameplan step sources cite them (CX-VAL-008, CX-EXEC-013).
